dedupe_keys.name: コカハス運行情報 bus and public transit

description: コガバス運行情報 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 古賀市. 古賀市のコミュニティバス「コガバス」の時刻表、経路、バス停の位置情報等が含まれたデータです。 国土交通省の定める「標準的なバス情報フォーマット」で公開します。. Coverage: 古賀市. The portal files it under the publisher 古賀市. Its tags are インフラ, バス, 交通とインフラ, 位置情報, 暮らし. It offers 6 resource(s) in gtfs-jp, zip. The portal shows 2025-01-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
